si4_title: Predicting Mental and Neurological Illnesses Based on Cerebellar Normative Features

dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Clinical datasets for patients (AD, ASD, BD, MCI, SZ) and their matched healthy controls were obtained from ABIDE I and II, ADNI, AIBL, DEMGEN, and TOP (including StrokeMRI). The normative model was built using a large reference sample (N=54,102) from the same pool as the cerebellar lifespan normative model described in Kim et al. (2024), which likely includes multiple unspecified datasets for the neurotypical population.
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The clinical datasets were obtained from the ABIDE I and II (Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange I and II), ADNI (Alzheimer ' s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative), AIBL (The Australian Imaging, Biomarkers and Lifestyle Flagship Study), DEMGEN (Norwegian Dementia Genetics Network), and TOP (Thematically Organized Psychosis) cohorts... The study sample consisted of individuals from the cerebellar lifespan normative model (15), where individuals without a diagnosis were split into a training set ( n = 27,117; 54% female), a test set ( n = 26,985; 53% females), and a clinical set ( n = 1757; 30% females)

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: ABIDE, ADNI, AIBL, DEMGEN, and TOP cohorts provided both the patients for the five clinical conditions (AD, ASD, BD, MCI, SZ) and the 1,757 healthy controls matched to them for prediction modeling. The large reference sample of neurotypicals (N=54,102) was split into training (n=27,117) and testing (n=26,985) sets to construct and evaluate the normative models.
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: individuals without a diagnosis were split into a training set ( n = 27,117; 54% female), a test set ( n = 26,985; 53% females), and a clinical set ( n = 1757; 30% females)... Individuals without diagnoses were matched to the clinical datasets of patients with AD, ASD, BD, MCI, and SZ... The clinical datasets were obtained from the ABIDE I and II... ADNI... AIBL... DEMGEN... and TOP cohorts.

dc3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norma.detail: Both models (lobular and voxelwise) were developed using the same reference sample of 54,102 neurotypicals (27,117 training and 26,985 testing). The 1,757 healthy controls in the clinical set were used as matched controls for the patient cohorts in the prediction phase, not for NM construction.
dc3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norma.supporting_text: individuals without a diagnosis were split into a training set ( n = 27,117; 54% female), a test set ( n = 26,985; 53% females), and a clinical set ( n = 1757; 30% females)... The cerebellar normative model was developed using a large reference sample... This normative model includes cerebellar lobules and voxelwise intensities

dc4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: Weighted mean = (27117*54.36 + 26985*54.52) / 54102 = 54.44. Pooled SD = sqrt( ((27117-1)*20.31^2 + (26985-1)*20.19^2) / (54102-2) ) = 20.25. Age info for the Training set (n=27,117, mean=54.36, SD=20.31) and Testing set (n=26,985, mean=54.52, SD=20.19) are from Table S2. Age range 3-85 is from the main text.
